welcome.title: Quoting, planning and billing for a home-care agency.
welcome.subtitle: From the first conversation with a family to the visit on the calendar and the invoice at the end of the month — one place, one record, one set of rules.
welcome.featuresLead: Nine things, in the order the work moves through the agency.
welcome.quotingBody: Turn a family's needs into dated, timed, priced service lines. Rates come from your catalogue, with Sunday and public-holiday surcharges and the right VAT applied per line.
welcome.validationBody: An assistant sitting with a family can write a quote; they do not set your prices. What they write waits in a queue until a manager approves it, and the record says who did.
welcome.planningBody: Accepted work becomes a week of visits — who goes where, in what order, with travel time and lunch accounted for. Re-planning the same week gives the same answer.
welcome.workforceBody: Contracts, working days, dated absences and who is on the rounds at all. Each assistant keeps their own record; a manager owns the parts that decide what they can be sent to.
welcome.qualificationsBody: Diplomas a manager records and skills an assistant declares. Both are hard constraints: nobody is ever scheduled for work they are not qualified to do.
welcome.customersBody: Addresses geocoded once, so every route is real. Contacts, registration status, and the portfolio each assistant actually serves.
welcome.mapBody: Every planned visit on one map over the window you choose, each pin carrying the assistant's photograph. "Who is where" answered without opening anything.
welcome.billingBody: Invoices generated from the visits that actually happened, validated by a manager, and emailed with the agency's own legal identity on them.
welcome.notificationsBody: A quote to approve, a plan that came back short, invoices waiting — the badge updates as it happens, without anybody refreshing a page.
welcome.rolesLead: Three roles, and each screen shows only what that role can act on.
welcome.forAssistantBody: Their own week as a calendar, the customers they serve, the quotes they have written, and the parts of their record that are theirs to change.
welcome.forManagerBody: The validation queue, the whole workforce, the planning and the map. Everything that decides what the agency has committed to.
welcome.forAdministratorBody: All of the above, plus the accounts, the catalogues, the planning rules and the agency's own legal and banking details.
welcome.ctaBody: Sign in with the account your agency gave you.
welcome.ctaSignedInBody: Sign out here, or use the navigation to carry on working.
welcome.footer: SimpleERP — quoting, workforce and intervention planning for a French home-care agency.

portal.noVisit: No visit is scheduled at the moment. A change you have asked for may still be waiting for the agency to confirm it.
portal.changeNeedsApproval: Cancelling or moving a visit sends the arrangement back to the agency. Nothing on it is scheduled until they confirm.
portal.cancelWarning: This removes the visit from the arrangement and sends the whole arrangement back to the agency to be agreed again. Until they confirm it, none of its visits are scheduled — not only this one.
portal.rescheduleWarning: The agency confirms the new time, and moving a visit onto a Sunday or a public holiday may change the price. Nothing is scheduled until they agree.
portal.windowExplained: Give the times you are available between. The agency places the visit somewhere inside that window, around the carer's round.
portal.windowInvalid: The end must fall after the start.
portal.noQuote: The agency has not written you a quote yet.
portal.noBill: You have not been invoiced yet.
portal.addressNotResolved: We could not place this address on the map. No visit can be planned until it is corrected.
